name: vyaaspeeth
description: Event & entertainment booking platform with a cinema-style seat map and security-first backend

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev:memory" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:mongo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
